title: Memory Leak in libcurl via Location Header Handling (CWE-770)
classified_slop_by: Daniel Stenberg gist 07f7581f6e3d78ef37dfbfc81fd1d1cd (AI slop security reports submitted to curl)
why_rejected: Closed on HackerOne as spam and listed as AI slop in Stenberg's gist. The reporter's own Valgrind run shows 0 bytes definitely lost (no leak), and the claimed leak rests on a code-analysis narrative that misreads curl's request-reset path; the report is explicitly AI-assisted. The public disclosure JSON exposes no maintainer comment text.
